uncovered_reasons.note: String concatenation of a string literal with a number product. Added a number type guard on result.time via a Result shape guard, a number guard on the product, and a string guard over the whole concatenation expression; dryrun showed no change (site stays generic), so the concat operator is not strength-reducible by annotations here.

Strict ===/!== comparisons of local boolean flags (n_limit, w_limit) against boolean literals. Fresh boolean type guards on the flags at these operands, and earlier a [boolean,undefined] union, produced no dryrun change; the comparisons remain generic.
